title: China's Nexchip Semiconductor says it aims to raise around $890.37M in its Hong Kong share sale by offering 216.2M shares at ~$4.12 per share (Rajasik Mukherjee/Reuters)
summary: Rajasik Mukherjee / Reuters: China's Nexchip Semiconductor says it aims to raise around $890.37M in its Hong Kong share sale by offering 216.2M shares at ~$4.12 per share — China's Nexchip Semiconductor (688249.SS) said on Wednesday it aims to raise around HK$6.98 billion ($890.37 million) in its Hong Kong share sale …
